biggest_catch: You need a referral link from a friend who already has a FUNDED Public account — there is no public signup path — plus a $1,000 initial one-time deposit of your own money, and the $100 reward's cash value is locked for 12 months (withdraw early and you pay up to $100). The program can be ended at Public's discretion with no notice.

steps: Get a unique referral link from a friend or family member who already has a funded Public Investing brokerage account in good standing — there is no public signup path for this offer.
Open a new Public brokerage account through that referral link and get approved.
Make an initial one-time deposit of at least $1,000 into the new brokerage account.
When Public alerts you that you are cleared to claim, pick your stock or ETF from the designated pool and claim the $100 reward within 30 days.
Do not withdraw the reward's cash value for 12 months after claiming, or the account may be charged an early withdrawal fee of up to $100.
timing: Claim within 30 days once cleared to claim; the cash value of the reward may not be withdrawn for 12 months after it is claimed.
